name: Woman Preaching
overview: Scripture acknowledges the role of women in proclaiming God's word, as seen in Psalms 68:11 where the Lord empowers a large company to publish His message. The New Testament affirms this calling by declaring that in the last days, both sons and daughters will prophesy through the Spirit (Acts 2:17). Additionally, Acts 21:9 records that four daughters of a believer actively engaged in prophecy, demonstrating that women did participate in speaking God's truth under the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
